title: Future Smartphone Enhanced Open Innovation Concepts
description: Three independently implementable concepts for future smartphones that treat the physical device itself as a programmable computing resource.

title: A Star-Inspired Framework for Transforming Nuclear Waste at the Source
description: A conceptual framework inspired by stellar nuclear transformation for reducing the long-term radiotoxicity and stewardship burden of nuclear waste.

title: Flux Logic Computing
description: A conceptual digital logic family in which binary information is represented by deterministic magnetic flux patterns rather than voltage ranges.

title: Seabed-Anchored Adaptive Ocean Energy Network
description: A conceptual marine-energy architecture using seabed power infrastructure, tethered hydrodynamic collectors, and a staged path toward open-sea validation.

title: External Modulation Frameworks for Predictable, Stable, and Safer Battery Systems
description: A systems-oriented framework exploring external modulation methods for improving battery predictability, operational stability, and safety.

title: Authenticated Logic-Zero Encoding via Passive Current Signature for Robust Low Voltage Signaling
description: A proposed signaling approach using passive current signatures to improve authentication and robustness in low-voltage logic systems.
